mapper.select: SELECT pi."id", pd.id AS sku_id, pp.id AS purchase_id, pc.id AS cost_id, ps.id AS sale_id, ppk.id AS pack_id, pl.id AS logistics_id FROM product_info pi INNER JOIN product_detail pd ON pi.id = pd.product_id AND pd.is_deleted = FALSE LEFT JOIN product_purchase pp ON pp.sku_id = pd."id" AND pp.is_deleted = FALSE LEFT JOIN product_cost pc ON pc.sku_id = pd."id" AND pc.is_deleted = FALSE LEFT JOIN product_sale ps ON ps.sku_id = pd."id" AND ps.is_deleted = FALSE LEFT JOIN product_pack ppk ON ppk.sku_id = pd."id" AND ppk.is_deleted = FALSE LEFT JOIN product_logistics pl ON pl.sku_id = pd."id" AND pl.is_deleted = FALSE WHERE pi.is_deleted = FALSE AND pd.id = #{skuId} LIMIT 1

SELECT pi."id", pd.images_url, pd.id as skuId, pd.sku_no, pd.product_state, pd.name, pd.name_en, pi.spu_no as spuNo, pi.name as spuName, pi.name_en as spuNameEn, pi.charge_name, pi.charge_id, pi.brand_name, pi.brand_id, pi.property, pi.property_id, pi.grade_id, pi.grade, pi.category, pi.category_id, pi.sale_method, pi.sell_spot, pi.function_desc, pi.usage_desc, pi.pirate_risk, pi.materials, pi.type, pi.iterate_ref_sku_id, pi.iterate_ref_sku_no, pd.plan_listing_time, pd.first_mass_product_date, pd.unit_id, unit.name AS unit_name, pd.product_state, pi.entrusted_develop_cost, pi.mold_cost, pi.sample_fee, pi.is_customized, pi.sales_channel, pd.status FROM product_info pi LEFT JOIN product_detail pd on pi.id = pd.product_id AND pd.is_deleted = FALSE LEFT JOIN product_unit unit ON pd.unit_id = unit.id AND unit.is_deleted = FALSE WHERE pi.is_deleted = FALSE AND pi.id = #{productId} LIMIT 1

SELECT pi."id", pd.images_url, pd.sku_no, pd.product_state, pd.name, pd.name_en, pi.spu_no as spuNo, pi.name as spuName, pi.name_en as spuNameEn, pi.charge_name, pi.charge_id, pi.brand_name, pi.brand_id, pi.property, pi.property_id, pi.grade_id, pi.grade, pi.category, pi.category_id, pi.sale_method, pi.sell_spot, pi.function_desc, pi.usage_desc, pi.pirate_risk, pi.materials, pi.type, pi.iterate_ref_sku_id, pi.iterate_ref_sku_no, pd.plan_listing_time, pd.first_mass_product_date, pd.unit_id, unit.name AS unit_name, pd.product_state, pi.entrusted_develop_cost, pi.mold_cost, pi.sample_fee, pi.is_customized, pi.sales_channel, pd.status FROM product_info pi LEFT JOIN product_detail pd on pi.id = pd.product_id AND pd.is_deleted = FALSE LEFT JOIN product_unit unit ON pd.unit_id = unit.id AND unit.is_deleted = FALSE WHERE pi.is_deleted = FALSE AND pd.id = #{skuId} LIMIT 1

SELECT pi."id", pi.spu_no, pi."name", pi.name_en, pi.charge_name, pi.charge_id, pi.brand_name, pi.brand_id, pi.property, pi.property_id, pi.grade_id, pi.grade, pi.category, pi.category_id, pi.sale_method, pi.sell_spot, pi.function_desc, pi.usage_desc, pi.pirate_risk, pi.materials, pi.entrusted_develop_cost, pi.mold_cost, pi.sample_fee, pi.is_customized, pi.sales_channel, pi.type, pi.iterate_ref_sku_id, pi.iterate_ref_sku_no FROM product_info pi WHERE pi.is_deleted = FALSE AND pi.id = #{productId}

SELECT brand_id, brand_name, category_id, category AS categoryName FROM product_info pi LEFT JOIN product_detail pd ON pd.product_id = pi.id AND pd.is_deleted = FALSE WHERE pd.sku_no = #{sku} AND pi.is_deleted = FALSE

SELECT pd.id AS sourceId, pd.product_id, pd.sku_no, pd.name FROM product_detail pd LEFT JOIN product_info pi ON pi.id = pd.product_id AND pi.is_deleted = FALSE WHERE pd.status = #{state} AND pd.is_deleted = FALSE
AND pd.sku_no ILIKE concat('%',#{searchKeyword}::text,'%') ORDER BY CASE WHEN pd.sku_no ILIKE concat('%',#{searchKeyword}::text,'%') THEN 1 ELSE 2 END, LENGTH(pd.sku_no), pd.sku_no;

SELECT id, product_id, sku_no, name, variant_property, plan_listing_time, unit_id, product_state, create_time, create_user_id, update_time, update_user_id, images_url, unit_name, charge_id, charge_name, create_user_name, update_user_name, status, process_id, business_process_id, is_change, first_mass_product_date, version, is_deleted, sync_kingdee_id FROM product_detail

select pd.id as sku_id, pd.sku_no from product_info pi inner join product_detail pd on pd.product_id = pi.id where pi.property in ('费用', '服务') and pd.status = 2 and pi.is_deleted = false and pd.is_deleted = false
SELECT id, charge_id, charge_name FROM product_detail WHERE is_deleted = false and string_to_array(charge_id, ',') && string_to_array(#{chargeId} , ',')

SELECT pd.sku_no , pd.name AS productName, pd.images_url, pi.category_id, pi.spu_no, pi.charge_name, pi.brand_name, pi.property AS propertyName, pi.materials, pi.usage_desc, ps.sale_state AS salesStatus, pp.gross_weight, pp.net_weight, pp.product_length as productLength, pp.product_width as productWidth, pp.product_height as productHeight, pc.actual_tax_cost, pc.actual_no_tax_cost, (SELECT ean FROM product_purchase WHERE sku_id=pd.id and is_deleted=FALSE LIMIT 1) AS ean FROM product_detail pd LEFT JOIN product_info pi ON pi.id = pd.product_id AND pi.is_deleted = FALSE LEFT JOIN product_pack pp ON pp.sku_id=pd.id AND pp.is_deleted= FALSE LEFT JOIN product_sale ps ON ps.sku_id=pd.id AND ps.is_deleted= FALSE LEFT JOIN product_cost pc ON pc.sku_id=pd.id AND pc.is_deleted= FALSE WHERE pd.is_deleted=FALSE AND pd.id=#{skuId}

SELECT pd.version, pd.id AS skuId, pi.id AS productId, pi.spu_no, pi.name AS spuName, pi.sale_method AS saleMethod, pd.sku_no, pi.spec_type, pd.images_url AS skuImagesUrl, pd.name AS skuName, pd.variant_property as variantProperty, pl.declare_chinese_name as declareName, pl.declare_model as declareModel, pl.product_property_id AS productPropertyId, pi.materials, pi.function_desc, pi.grade AS productGrade, pi.brand_name as brandName, ps.sale_state as saleState, pd.unit_name, pd.status, pp.moq, pp.main_supplier as supplierId, pc.actual_tax_cost, pc.target_tax_cost, pc.retail_price, ppk.product_length as productLength, ppk.product_width as productWidth, ppk.product_height as productHeight, ppk.net_weight FROM product_detail pd LEFT JOIN product_info pi ON pi.id = pd.product_id AND pi.is_deleted = FALSE left join product_logistics pl on pd.id = pl.sku_id AND pl.is_deleted = FALSE left join product_sale ps on pd.id = ps.sku_id and ps.is_deleted = FALSE LEFT JOIN product_purchase pp ON pp.sku_id = pd."id" AND pp.is_deleted = FALSE LEFT JOIN product_cost pc ON pc.sku_id = pd."id" AND pc.is_deleted = FALSE LEFT JOIN product_pack ppk ON ppk. sku_id = pd."id" AND ppk.is_deleted = FALSE WHERE ${params.sqlMap.default} and pi.is_deleted = FALSE AND pd.is_deleted = FALSE

select id,sku_id,spu_no,sku_no,productName from ( select pi."id", pd.id AS sku_id, pi.spu_no, pi.name as productName, pd.sku_no FROM product_info pi INNER JOIN product_detail pd ON pi.id = pd.product_id AND pd.is_deleted = FALSE WHERE pi.is_deleted = FALSE AND pd.sku_no ILIKE concat('%',#{params.remoteSearchSku}::text,'%')
AND string_to_array(pi.sale_method,',') && string_to_array(#{params.saleMethod},',')
order by case when pd.sku_no ILIKE concat(#{params.remoteSearchSku}::text,'%') THEN 1 when pd.sku_no ILIKE concat('%',#{params.remoteSearchSku}::text) THEN 2 when pd.sku_no ILIKE concat('%',#{params.remoteSearchSku}::text,'%') THEN 3 end , pd.sku_no ) sku_detail

SELECT pd."id", pd.sku_no AS skuNo FROM product_detail pd LEFT JOIN product_customs pc ON pc.sku_id = pd."id" and country = 'default' AND pc.is_deleted = FALSE WHERE pd.is_deleted = FALSE AND pd.status = '2' AND pc.to_declare_price = 0

select skuId,productId,spu_no,spuName,sku_no,status,skuImagesUrl,skuName,variant_property,unitQty,declareName,declareModel,unit_name from ( SELECT pd.id AS skuId, pi.id AS productId, pi.spu_no, pi.name AS spuName, pd.sku_no, pd.status, pd.images_url AS skuImagesUrl, pd.name AS skuName, pd.variant_property, pp.box_qty as unitQty, pl.declare_chinese_name as declareName, pl.declare_model as declareModel, pd.unit_name FROM product_detail pd LEFT JOIN product_info pi ON pi.id = pd.product_id AND pi.is_deleted = FALSE left join product_pack pp on pd.id = pp.sku_id AND pp.is_deleted = FALSE left join product_logistics pl on pd.id = pl.sku_id AND pl.is_deleted = FALSE WHERE pd.is_deleted = FALSE
AND pd.status in
#{status}
AND pd.sku_no ILIKE concat('%',#{params.searchKeyword}::text,'%')
order by
case when pd.sku_no ILIKE concat(#{params.searchKeyword}::text,'%') THEN 1 when pd.sku_no ILIKE concat('%',#{params.searchKeyword}::text) THEN 2 when pd.sku_no ILIKE concat('%',#{params.searchKeyword}::text,'%') THEN 3 end,
pd.sku_no asc ) pds

SELECT pd.id AS skuId, pd.sku_no FROM product_detail pd LEFT JOIN product_info pi ON pi.id = pd.product_id AND pi.is_deleted = FALSE
LEFT JOIN product_sale ps ON pd.id = ps.sku_id AND ps.is_deleted = FALSE WHERE pd.status = 2 AND pi.property not IN ('费用', '服务') AND pi.is_deleted = FALSE AND ps.listing_time is not null
